+title: Adopt default-inferable operations from FoundationModelsExtras 09d38f9
+---
+FoundationModelsExtras main 09d38f9 sets the default of `OperationDefinition.isInferable` to `true`. `isInferable: false` is now an opt-out. An op-less guess can now run an operation with side effects. Adopt this rule in Skills.
+
+- [ ] Update the FoundationModelsExtras dependency to 09d38f9. Make sure that Package.resolved shows 09d38f9.
+- [ ] Remove the redundant `static let isInferable = true` declarations in UseSkill, SearchSkill, ListSkill, ReadResource and ListResource.
+- [ ] Make sure that `PlainTextMarker` passes the flag of its target.
+- [ ] Change the tests that expect an op-less call to be refused only because the operation was not inferable. Make them assert that the inferred operation runs.
+- [ ] Update docs/operations.md, README and the doc comments in SkillsTool.swift and PlainTextOperations.swift: every operation is inferable unless it opts out; `defaultOp` settles a tie.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` and one full `swift test` pass with zero failures and no new warnings.
\ No newline at end of file
